fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-07-26 at about 00:30, it was reported that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 96,000 was withdrawn. The complaint was lodged by Hemanth Nathan (9000000110). Madhan Babu (mobile 9000000490) was named as a possible person of interest. A second person, Ajith Nathan (9000000297), was also mentioned as possibly present. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, phone records, mobile number, main street, suspect, night
